full.description: This image is a photomicrograph of lung tissue stained with Gomori's methenamine silver (GMS). It shows numerous dark-staining cysts characteristic of Pneumocystis jirovecii within an alveolar exudate. The spherical and helmet-shaped cysts are typical of this organism. The findings support a diagnosis of Pneumocystis pneumonia.

random.description: This is a photomicrograph of lung tissue stained with Gomori methenamine silver (GMS). The section reveals numerous dark, cup-shaped cysts scattered within an alveolar exudate. The morphological appearance and staining characteristics are classic for Pneumocystis jirovecii organisms. The findings are diagnostic of Pneumocystis pneumonia.
